scenarios.request_shape: The user explicitly enables Debug Mode for one named engineering task.
required_outcomes: current task scope and request reference

scenarios.request_shape: A task starts after a previous debugged task or only asks for analysis without explicitly enabling Debug Mode.
A human requests one broad dependency check and Alatyr derives several concrete affected paths and tests.
required_outcomes: causal references to the human event
no independent attribution for derived findings

scenarios.request_shape: A human architectural review changes the accepted solution direction after an initially working implementation.
required_outcomes: structured architectural impacts on the human correction
replacement invariant or architecture direction caused by the rejection
derived implementation and validation events preserve the human causal chain

scenarios.request_shape: The session contains raw dialogue, credentials, and speculative reasoning that did not affect the task.
required_outcomes: no secrets credentials or unused speculation

scenarios.request_shape: The assisted implementation will be contributed to a repository that does not adopt Alatyr support files.
required_outcomes: debug record retained in target-approved storage
no .ai path in the external patch

scenarios.request_shape: The user compares supervision burden across completed Debug Mode records.
required_outcomes: no causal improvement claim from intervention count alone

scenarios.request_shape: A Debug result links an event-local, unknown, or multiply indexed value as durable engineering evidence.
required_outcomes: every non-empty evidence ID resolves exactly once in the Engineering Evidence index
an empty list remains valid when no durable evidence record exists

scenarios.request_shape: A user asks to include an active or abandoned Debug record in finalized cross-task metrics.
required_outcomes: only completed records enter finalized comparison
no premature final metrics are claimed
